```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Setup
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)


## Libraries
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)

## Functions
expit <- function(log_odds){
  exp(log_odds)/(1 + exp(log_odds))
}

logit <- function(p){
  log(p/(1-p))
}
## Load Data

brfss_prevs <- read.csv("data - clean/BRFSS_HT_AP_prevs.csv")
yrbs_prevs <- read.csv("data - clean/YRBS_HT_AP_prevs.csv")

prevs <- bind_rows(brfss_prevs, yrbs_prevs)

combined <- readRDS("data - clean/combined.rds")
```
```{r f_tables}
# Make femable table
## Get total sample size by sex, age + period
totals <- combined %>%
  rename("period" = "year") %>% 
  group_by(sex, period, age) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(so = "total",
                   mean = n(),
                   se = NA,
                   logit_pijk = n(),
                   var = NA,
                   var_logit_pijk = NA)

prevs %>%
  bind_rows(totals) %>% 
  arrange(sex, age, period) %>% 
  filter(sex == "Female") %>% 
  select(age, period, so, logit_pijk, var_logit_pijk) %>% 
  ## Format Phat (CI) for table
  mutate(table_cell = 
           ifelse(so == "total", sprintf("N = %.0f", logit_pijk),
                  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f, %.1f)", 
                          100*expit(logit_pijk),
                          100*expit(logit_pijk -
                                      qnorm(0.975)*sqrt(var_logit_pijk)),
                          100*expit(logit_pijk +
                                      qnorm(0.975)*sqrt(var_logit_pijk))))) %>% 
  ## Make years columns
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("age", "so"),
              values_from = "table_cell",
              names_from = "period",
              values_fill = "--") %>% 
  ## Order rows within age
  mutate(so = factor(so, levels = c("lesgay", "bi", "dko", "ref", "total"))) %>% 
  arrange(age, so) %>% 
  ## Relocate years in proper order
  relocate("2014", .before = "2015") %>% 
  relocate("2016", .before = "2017") %>% 
  relocate("2018", .before = "2019") %>% 
  relocate("2020", .before = "2021") %>% 
  ## Capitalize Age column
  rename("Age" = "age") %>%
  ## Remove SO column
  select(-so) %>% 
  ## Make table
  flextable() %>% 
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>% 
  ## Caption 
  set_caption(fp_p = officer::fp_par(text.align = "left"),
              caption = as_paragraph(
                as_b("Sample sizes and estimated prevalences with 95% confidence intervals (CI) by age and period for male respondents."),
                " Estimates are color-coded by SO: lesbian/gay (red), ",
                "bisexual (yellow), some other response (green), or ",
                "declined to answer (blue). Sample sizes are in black.",
                " Note: estimates and standard errors account for the ",
                "survey design, and are calculated using the survey package ",
                "in R. CIs are calculated on the log-odds scale and ",
                "transformed back to the probability scale ensuring CIs ",
                "do not extend beyond the interval (0,1).")) %>% 
  ## Sort out aesthetics for a long table in word
  paginate(group = "Age", init = FALSE, hdr_ftr = FALSE) %>% 
  ## Set table width
  fit_to_width(max_width = 7.5, unit = "in") %>%
  ## Set font and size
  fontsize(part = "all", size = 8) %>% 
  flextable::font(part = "all", fontname = "Times New Roman") %>% 
  ## Change cell height & width
  height(height = 0.1, part = "body") %>% 
  width(j = 2:9, width = 7/8, unit = "in") %>% 
  width(j = 1, width = 0.5, unit = "in") %>% 
  # bg(bg = "grey80", i = 1:20, j = seq(2, 9, 2)) %>% 
  ## Change cell white space
  padding(padding.top = 0.5, padding.bottom = 0.5,
          padding.left = 4, padding.right = 4, part = "body") %>% 
  ## Bold header
  bold(part = "header") %>% 
  ## Merge ages 
  merge_v(j = 1) %>% 
  ## Customize "total" rows
  bold(i = seq(5, 330, 5), j = 2:9) %>%
  hline(i = seq(5, 330, 5)) %>% 
  ## Customize "lesgay" rows
  color(i = seq(1, 330, 5), j = 2:9,
        color = "firebrick") %>%
  ## Customize "bi" rows
  color(i = seq(2, 330, 5), j = 2:9, 
        color = "goldenrod") %>%
  ## customize "dko" rows
  color(i = seq(3, 330, 5), j = 2:9,
        color = "forestgreen") %>% 
  ## customize "ref" rows
  color(i = seq(4, 330, 5), j = 2:9,
        color = "navy")
```
